Mismanagement at IGIA
†595. SHRI P.K. MAHESHWARI:
SHRI RAMA SHANKER
KAUSHIK:
Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION
be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government's attention has
been drawn to mismanagement prevailing
at the Indira Gandhi International Airport;
(b) if so, whether a sum of Rs. 700 is
charged from the passengers in the name of
providing them certain facilities free of cost
inside the airport;
(c) if so, whether the passengers arestill
made to pay additional money atthe timeof
availing of these facilities;
(d) if so, the reasons therefor and also
the reasons for seepage of rain water from
the roof of the Departure Hall ofthe said
airport; and
(e) the steps taken by Government to do
away with such mismanagement?
Smart Card Scheme of AAI
†596. DR. A.K. PATEL: Will the
Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be pleased
to state:
(a) the details of the 'Smart Card' scheme
announced by the Airports Authority of
India;
(b) whether the said card has been given
by the Authority to its employees; and
(c) if so, the time taken in providing these
cards after the said announcement?
Inadequate facilities at airports
†597. SHRI JANESHWAR MISHRA:
Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that due to
irregularities, mismanagement and
inadequate facilities at airports, passengers
and their relatives have to face various
problems;
(b) whether it is also a fact that due to
non-maintenance of buildings and their
deteriorated condition people have to stand
in water in rainy days;
(c) if so, whether it is also a fact that
despite charging extra amount from the
passengers no attention is being paid towards
their facilities;
(d) if so, whether Government will take
steps to provide better facilities to the
passengers; and

(e) if so, by when and the details
thereof?
Recovery of outstanding dues from
international airlines
598. SHRI GHULAM NABI AZAD:
Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have decided
to take legal action to recover cumulative
outstanding dues from 89 leading
international airlines;
(b) if so, whether these dues have to be
recovered by various Government
companies and departments including Air
India, Airports Authority of India, the
revenue department, etc.;
(c) whether Government are also
considering to adjust the amount against
security deposits of these defaulters; and
(d) if so, the total outstanding dues from
these airlines?
Reduction of employees in AI flights
599. SHRI SANTOSH BAGRODIA:
Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Air India has
the highest number of employees per aircraft
in the world;
(b) if so, the details in comparison with
other international flights; and
(c) what is Government's plans to reduce
the number?
Losses suffered by aviation sector after
terrorists attack in USA
600. SHRI MOOLCHAND MEENA:
Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) whether consequent upon the
September 11, 2001 events in the US, the
aviation industry is likely to suffer a loss of
$6 million this year;
(b) if so, whether the industry has lost
$12 billion last year;
(c) whether the industry is ona recovery
path but still not reached a stage of
profitability;
(d) if so, the steps Government propose
to take to help the aviation sector to come
out of the red;
(e) whether any concrete policy in this
regard have been formulated;and
(f) if so, the details thereof?
Air accidents
601. DR. AKHILESH DAS:
DR. KARAN SINGH:
Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that as per Civil
Aviation authorities at least 24 per cent of th
total air disasters in the country fall in the
category of "deliberate error";
(b) if so, the number and details of air
accidents during 2000-2001, 2001-2002
and the 2002-2003 so far, attributable to
such "deliberate error" together with those
which  involved small aircraft; and
(c) the steps taken and being taken to
prevent such accidents?
Aircraft purchase by IA
602. SHRI SHRI RAMAMUNI
REDDY SIRIGIREDDY:
SHRI RAMA MOHANA RAO:
Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Indian Airlines
is purchasing 43 aircraft from Airbus
